title: Shulker box without end
description:
Allows you to craft shulkerboxes without going to the end
uses 7 obsidian 1 chest and 1 diamond
body:
A datapack I developed that allows you to craft shulkerboxes without going to the end.

Uses 7 obsidian 1 chest and 1 diamond.

Good for servers where the end is closed and its balanced to not be easily farmable
